question: Should this inverse branch remain as explicitly non-mergeable rollback material while https://github.com/openclaw/clawsweeper/pull/851 is reviewed, or should rollback artifacts be closed and recreated only if an incident requires them?
rationale: The branch deliberately has no intended production landing path, so whether to retain it is a repository workflow and incident-response choice rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Keep it as a draft-only rollback reference
options.body: Leave the branch unretargeted and unmerged until the paired primary fix has a final maintainer outcome.

options.title: Close the rollback artifact
options.body: Close this draft and require any future rollback to be proposed from current main with fresh diagnosis and validation.

recommendation.title: Keep it as a draft-only rollback reference
recommendation.body: Leave the branch unretargeted and unmerged until the paired primary fix has a final maintainer outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged publication-head ratchet is the central durable-state behavior that the paired fix and this rollback branch affect.
